text:
Maria Chen: Quick proposal — change Dedicated tenant burst behavior to a soft burst cap + leaky refill window. Trying to reduce noisy-neighbor fallout without hard 429s.

AJ Patel: 👍 can you sketch the rules? soft cap = ? refill = ? how do we surface in console?

Maria Chen: Thinking: soft_cap = 2x reserved_throughput, warn when above reserved, start smoothing at 1.2x, gradual token drain rather than abrupt reject. Refill window = sliding 5m with per-tenant leaky bucket. Console shows current burst_balance and predicted depletion time.

Selena Ortiz: Concern: if soft cap allows 2x but sustained, that kills other tenants. Need per-node isolation too — per-tenant node hints and headroom reservation.

Kenji Saito: Agree with Selena. On node level we should enforce a strict isolation threshold (node_reserved_headroom = 20%) that can't be borrowed. Soft cap would only apply within tenant's allocated pool.

Rahul Menon: From telemetry side: we need new metrics: tenant.burst_balance, tenant.burst_refill_rate, tenant.sustained_1m_qps, node.headroom_util. Also record decisions when fallback routing triggers.

Maria Chen: Good call. I'll add the node_reserved_headroom. Proposal v0.1 for rate-limiter config (pseudo):

```
rate_limiters:
  tenant:
    reserved_qps: 200
    soft_cap_multiplier: 2.0
    smoothing_threshold: 1.2
    refill_window_seconds: 300
    hard_min_headroom_pct: 20
```

Kenji Saito: That config looks fine. Edge case: burst credits accumulation on idle accounts — do we cap accumulation? otherwise long-idle tenant could drain system.

Maria Chen: Yes, cap at reserved_qps * 10 or a fixed cap (TBD). Prefer per-tenant cap = 8x reserved. Open to ideas.

AJ Patel: UX: console alert when smoothing starts + link to quota insights. Also an explainer for customers: "Why you saw slower-than-expected burst". Can we show predicted failover routes?

Sasha Green: For rollout: canary in staging, then 5% of prod traffic for 24h, monitor tenant.burst_balance and node.headroom_util. If tail latency > 99th baseline + 10ms abort.

Rahul Menon: I'll add dashboards and an alert runbook. Alert: node.headroom_util > 85% for 10m or tenant.sustained_1m_qps > 5x reserved without refill.

Maria Chen: TL;DR next steps: PR for limiter + telemetry tags (owner: Maria), console prototype (owner: AJ), node headroom guard (owner: Kenji), canary plan (owner: Sasha). Can we sync tomorrow 10am?

AJ Patel: 10am works. Can you drop an agenda?

Maria Chen: Will do. Thanks all :rocket:
